title: Fold kctx.rs byte-copy into the shared knowledge module
action: Delete packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/kctx.rs by promoting its shared surface: widen visibility on the knowledge-module functions it duplicates (verbs/knowledge/anchor.rs, context.rs, promote.rs — the ranges named in drivers/mod.rs:194-217), point verbs/drivers/prepare.rs:277-295,359-372 and any other kctx callers at the knowledge module, remove the kctx mod declaration and the byte-parity test that compared the two copies (its purpose dies with the copy — record that in the commit body). Keep behavior identical: no logic changes, only visibility widening and call-site retargeting. The existing knowledge/kctx test suites are the proof.
goal: One source of truth for the knowledge-context surface; the next Anchor arm is a single edit and the linter sees all of it.
verify: PATH cargo test --release green, including knowledge tests; kctx.rs gone; no remaining references to drivers::kctx.

trace.outcome: Deleted drivers/kctx.rs's byte-copy; prepare.rs now calls the pub(crate) knowledge module directly
